Surgical needle components: 3

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A needle is supplied with the suture permanently attached by the manufacturer, without the user threading a separate eye. Which attachment design describes this continuous needle-suture unit commonly used in modern wound closure?

  1. Needle body
  2. Reverse-cutting needle
  3. Taper-point needle
  4. Swaged attachment
  5. Needle point
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Swaged attachment

A swaged needle is manufactured attached to the suture without a separate threaded eye.

Understanding the options

Swaged attachment
A swaged needle is manufactured attached to the suture without a separate threaded eye.
Needle point
The point initiates tissue penetration and its geometry is selected for tissue characteristics. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Needle body
The body provides the shape and strength used to carry the needle through tissue. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Reverse-cutting needle
The main cutting edge lies on the convex curvature and is commonly used for skin. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Taper-point needle
A rounded taper separates rather than cuts tissue and is used for many easily penetrated soft tissues. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
